first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and simplifying signup can improve completion, time-to-value, and durable first-week activation. This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, whose prior retention harm creates downstream value risk despite current competitive pressure. Verify the two most directly relevant records before finalizing the experiment design.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The confirmed source evidence directly addresses both current declines: completion increased 13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%. Signup simplification provides supporting SMB evidence but had a 1% retention decline and was not replicated outside SMB, so it should not be broadly rolled out or treated as equivalent evidence. Monitor qualified revenue and retention as guardrails.
